pages.title: Truth Mirror
pages.text: Raise the Truth Mirror for three seconds to reveal your true self — shed your feral shape and become human once more.

pages.title: Crafting
pages.text: Copper corners, glass panes at the sides, an Astral Matrix above, a Totem of Undying below, and a Murmol Soul at the center.

pages.title: The Hanging Mirror
pages.text: $(thing)Sneak-right-click$(0) to hang the Truth Mirror on any of the six faces of a block, like a mounted mirror.$(br)$(thing)Right-click$(0) the mirror to shine its light upon yourself — gain $(thing)10 seconds of Reveal$(0): while the effect lasts, shapeshifters take on their human form; humans instead reveal the demon within.$(br)Right-click again to refresh the duration.$(br)Care to take a look?
